correctness.rationale: C PASS. Define X=S−alpha, Y=theta+alpha K. Mutually exclusive join-first and open-new indicators give E[I J|state]=0 and exact recurrence C_{j+1}=(1+(1+alpha)/(theta+j))C_j−u_jv_j/(theta+j)^2. First moments solve in rising factorials; induction gives the negative boxed finite covariance for every n≥2 and admissible real alpha,theta. Independent beta-binomial tagged-block variance, square-integrable martingale second factorial moments for block count when alpha>0, and independent new-table Bernoullis at alpha=0 yield the claimed distinct correlation limits. Exact rational joint state DP checks n=2..14 across four parameter pairs; infinite scope follows analytic recurrence.

evidence: No admissible straightforward specialization yields the claimed rising-factorial expression; evaluating a weighted sum of all r frequency covariances is substantive.

value.rationale: V PASS. A tagged block size is a natural size-biased observation in species sampling, and the total number of blocks measures diversity. Their exact finite negative covariance and sharp distinction between positive discount and Dirichlet boundary correlations are structural dependence results with use in prediction and uncertainty estimation; they are not a routine named-table recomputation.

limitations: Fixed real alpha,theta within allowed two-parameter CRP; first-tagged table only, not ranked block or arbitrary Gibbs partition; no joint varying-alpha n limit.
